name: Bompa's Blueberry Farm
description: In South High Street, OR, Bompa's Blueberry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer, autumn, and spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
